<!--
Thanks for helping! A few things before you start:
- Base branch: **staging** (not main). Your branch: feat/…, fix/…, docs/… or chore/… in your fork.
- Title: one line saying what changes, e.g. "Read Codex CLI's session logs".
  It becomes the commit message when this is merged.
- Something big? Open an issue first, so we agree on the shape.
See CONTRIBUTING.md for more. Lines like this one are hidden; you can leave them.
-->

## What kind of change

<!-- Keep the one that fits. -->
- [ ] New: a feature, a program for Lody to read, a language or a voice (`feat/`)
- [ ] Fix: something that didn't work (`fix/`)
- [ ] Docs: README, CONTRIBUTING, comments (`docs/`)
- [ ] Chore: build, checks, tidying, nothing users notice (`chore/`)

## What this changes, and why

<!-- A few sentences. For a new program: which one, and what Lody reads from it.
     For a fix: what went wrong before. Link an issue if there is one: "Closes #12". -->

## How I tested it

<!-- What you tried, and what happened. -->
- [ ] Windows
- [ ] macOS
- [ ] Linux

<!-- Something you can see (the settings window, the overlay)? A screenshot helps. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets` and `cargo test` pass
- [ ] A new program has tests with real, trimmed lines from it, and nothing private in them
- [ ] README or CONTRIBUTING.md updated if something users or contributors see changed
